list_entry.title: The human brain and its associated

A.explanation:
This is a rule that would help us conclude whether something was / wasn't based on the human brain and its associated mental capacities.

We want a rule that helps us conclude how we should evaluate something.

B.explanation:
This is a rule that would allow us to conclude that something "can't be evaluated".

We want a rule that would allow us to conclude that "this is how we should evaluate" something.

C.explanation:
Aesthetic judgments evolved / developed to serve the function of assisting self-preservation / survival.

So according to this rule, the standard by which we must evaluate aesthetic judgments is how well it serves the function of self-preservation / survival.

That's a fantastic match for our conclusion.

D.explanation:
This is a rule that would allow us to conclude that something "can't be evaluated as true or false".

But that doesn't mean that we can conclude "we SHOULD evaluate it based on how it impacts survival value".

E.explanation:
This is a rule that would allow us to conclude that something "should be highly valued".

We want a rule that would allow us to conclude that "we should evaluate this [something] based on how it contributes to survival value".
